dimension: inactivity pathway and future engagement intention

method.distance: equal-weight Gower on four original nominal/binary survey responses
method.pac_policy: comparative only; no universal absolute cutoff

names.1: Work-and-education engaged, mostly prior work experience
names.2: Low/uncertain engagement, mostly no prior work experience

decision.status: Retained as exploratory future-engagement/prior-work-experience profiles; inactivity reason is descriptive rather than defining
decision.interpretation_scope: future engagement intention and prior work experience; current inactivity reason does not distinguish the final profiles

limitations: These are exploratory inactivity-pathway and future-engagement response profiles, not permanent youth types.
The 13-category inactivity reason is nominal and has the same maximum distance weight as each binary/intention question.
Future work and education answers are stated intentions, not a validated readiness scale or guarantee of future behaviour.
Leave-one-feature-out and single-feature checks are essential because inactivity reason could directly dominate the partition.
Removing inactivity reason reproduces the final partition (ARI 1.000), so it must be described within profiles rather than claimed as their defining separation.
If no candidate satisfies the cross-algorithm minimum-size rule, the selected solution is retained only to diagnose the rejection and must not be used as a profile classification.
Permutation calibration tests whether the selected structure exceeds independently shuffled variables, but it does not establish theoretical construct validity.
The Branch G sample contains only 56 valid respondents; confirmation in additional data is required.
